policy: Every capability has a canonical owner, contract, implementation boundary, evaluation method and adoption state.
build_rules: Build when capability is CFIP domain IP or no adequate reusable implementation exists.
Integrate when stable implementation fits contract and gates.
Adapt when framework needs isolation behind a stable adapter.
Evaluate/Benchmark when workload evidence is incomplete.
Reference when useful architecture/patterns must not become runtime dependency.
Fork only after upstream/adapter/extension/patch analysis and with maintenance ownership.

canonical_runtime_policy.search: one production search composition after benchmark
canonical_runtime_policy.vector: one primary vector strategy after benchmark; pgvector preferred for low-sprawl option
canonical_runtime_policy.graph: optional projection, not default system of record
canonical_runtime_policy.workflow: one workflow engine only if durable orchestration is proven necessary
canonical_runtime_policy.trading: one generic engine boundary; CFIP domain intelligence remains outside generic engine
canonical_runtime_policy.agent: one Elyrava contract with replaceable adapters
